caption:
✍️ 'To + verb' isn't a main verb

✅ Rule: An infinitive can't be the main verb of a sentence.
❌ The council, to approve the plan in May.
✅ The council approved the plan in May.
✅ Quick check: Fragments are a top SAT trap.
